clips.title: The story
paras: This quest marks the final chapter in Viktori Prism'Antras's endeavor to assemble a stargazing device in Darkshire. With the telescope structure otherwise built, Viktori sends travelers to the dangerous Vul'Gol Ogre Mound to retrieve a lens large enough for his contraption: a monocle worn by the ogre Zzarc'Vul.

Throughout the construction of his stargazing telescope, Viktori Prism'Antras has relied on plans drafted by the gnome engineer Cog Glitzspinner. While brass tubes and sturdy mountings could be scavenged or assembled from local supplies, the apparatus required an exceptionally massive focusing lens. Standard magnifying glasses and optical components from Stormwind traders simply lacked the diameter called for by Cog's ambitious design, leading Viktori to look toward an unlikely and perilous alternative.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device. Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort. The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.
There is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood. If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?

clips.title: Completion
paras: At last! The stargazing device is complete! Thank you, friend. Now I can continue my research...
